head_coach.name: Ronald Koeman
head_coach.play_style_summary: An attacking, possession-based tactical style derived from the Johan Cruyff school of thought. It focuses on structured build-up from defensive areas, a solid midfield double-pivot, and inside-cutting wide forwards who generate dynamic passing sequences and balanced offensive movement.

key_players.name: Cody Gakpo
key_players.performance_stats: In the 2025/2026 Premier League season, he recorded a 7.17 FotMob rating, completing 84.1% of his passes, creating 10 big chances, and averaging 2.9 shots per 90 minutes.

key_players.name: Donyell Malen
key_players.performance_stats: An explosive attacker who registered 14 goals in 18 Serie A appearances for Roma on loan from Aston Villa in 2025/2026, posting a 7.15 average rating and a 79.1% passing accuracy in European play.

key_players.name: Virgil van Dijk
key_players.performance_stats: The veteran captain won 73.2% of his duels and averaged 6.76 clearances per game during the 2025/2026 season, registering an average FotMob rating of 7.26 in the Premier League.
